detail: Red on set bdd4f40c4 (hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/fill-wt/native-fill-e2e) and set 55ff708a6 (lat1:/tank/fn/scratch/fill-wt/native-fill-e2e-lat1-55; scenario_suite run e2e); logs/test-tests.test_native_control.log. Exit 3 in two of the three suggests the operator verbs now fault (owner-quantum fault / process stopped) where they used to refuse; compare with SCEN-PINV-CONFIRM-ARITY (same exit 4 'fault operator peer' class on 3403e5ac2).
notes: Reply-kind test: tests/test_native_control.py test_the_reply_is_the_owners_status took the first (member (first status) ...) list in fnn-control-handle-client (host/native/control.lisp:503, the stop-cut exclusion of :live-status-reply/:sealed-reply). The contract is the list at :506 that feeds (second status) to the after-submit hook (the ACL2 consumer/topic reply kinds), so the TEST was wrong and is fixed: it selects the last reply-kind list before '(second status) status))' and also pins the preceding exclusion list.

Failed-startup close: fnn-control-close (control.lisp) compared the existing path's socket stat dev/ino with the NIL device/inode of a run whose control-start never bound (lease refused: another store owns the path; or the port taken before the start hooks ran, leaving a SIGKILLed owner's stale node). The type error was caught as a failed close hook (owner.lisp fnn-owner-run: modules-joined nil), giving the held-close exit 3 in place of the original refusal (EXIT_REFUSED 1) and 'last-stop exit=03'. Fix: the decision is ACL2's, books/native-control.lisp fn-native-control-socket-removal (keystone -decides, -teeth: unset installed identity and a different inode never remove), reached via fn-native-control-host-socket-removal from fnn-control-unlink-installed (control-transport.lisp), now the one unlink path of control.lisp, bp-control.lisp and dev-repl.lisp (their host-side dev/ino comparisons are gone).

Stale control list: fnn-operator-execute-admin (operator.lisp) sent accepted queries (control list, peer list) straight to fnn-operator-status-once, bypassing the PKT-344 liveness observation (fnn-operator-live-admin-observe, operator-control-client.lisp) that removes a crashed owner's socket and prints 'stale control socket removed'. Fix: the query arm takes the observation (queryp t) first.

host/native-control-host.lisp now includes books/owner-state-accessors (fn-nco-owner-publication-word used fn-owner-sco-global without it; the book failed Translate when certified alone, a defect of the control-receipt lane).

Evidence: lane/control-3-red; books/native-control and host/native-control-host certified on persvati (farm.py submit --lane --affected-by). The native run (persvati native-c3r-21d396b1b) died at host-ld before any image: definterface FN-OWNER-TRANSIT-OUTCOME's keystone function fn-oop-transit-outcome is not in its call closure (s-catchup-k c11979cb3, train 46; the same red as CONVERGE-20261008-4, S owns it). tests.test_native_control and tests.test_native_operator_cli therefore still owe a native run once dev builds images.
title: tests.test_native_control 3F: test_health_and_status_say_the_node_is_not_running_and_why gets 'last-stop exit=03'; test_shared_control_path_is_not_stolen_by_another_store gets exit 3 where EXIT_REFUSED (1) is expected; test_sigkilled_owner_socket_is_stale_and_control_list_runs_offline lacks 'stale control socket removed' (only 'accepted operator control')
